company_profile.summary: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd (IndiGo) is India's largest passenger airline and the third largest low-cost carrier in the world. Commanding over 62% domestic aviation market share with a fleet of over 380 aircraft, IndiGo operates 2,000+ daily flights connecting 85+ domestic destinations and 30+ international hubs.

revenue_breakup.desc: Scheduled domestic and international passenger seat fares.
Baggage fees, seat selection, onboard meals (6E Eats), travel insurance, and cargo handling.
Aircraft leaseback gains, credit card partnerships, and frequent flyer program royalties.

moats_and_strengths: Dominant domestic market share (>62%) creating insurmountable route network density and airport slot dominance.
Young, highly fuel-efficient all-Airbus A320neo and A321neo fleet delivering lowest cost per available seat kilometer (CASK).
Punctuality and reliability leadership with highest on-time performance (OTP) in Indian aviation.
Massive order book of nearly 1,000 Airbus aircraft (including A321XLR and A350 widebodies) securing growth through 2035.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Active Fleet: 380+ aircraft • Aircraft Order Backlog: ~950 Airbus aircraft (including 30 widebody A350s)

bullish_triggers: Induction of Airbus A321XLR and A350 widebody aircraft opening non-stop routes to Europe, East Asia, and Australia.
Launch of 'IndiGo Stretch' business class cabins capturing high-yield corporate travelers.
Expanding bilateral international air traffic rights from Indian metro airports.
bearish_risks: Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) price volatility driven by international crude oil fluctuations.
Pratt & Whitney GTF engine grounding issues temporarily idling a portion of the A320neo fleet.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
